thread:
Olivia: PR #10421 ready to merge — minor model-routing fix. Need to land before the rebase window / deploy-freeze at 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. CI is green locally but flaky in pipeline. Any blockers?

Rahul: looks fine from code read. eng-releases CI queue is long atm. Current backfill ETA ~3h. @CI-bot can you post queue status?

CI-bot: Queue length: 12 jobs ahead. Estimated start for PR #10421: ~2h40m. Recent integration flake rate: ~7%.

Jess: left a tiny nits comment, pushed a draft fix. Also saw the integration flake earlier — failing test was `test_kv_cache_eviction`. Might need a deterministic seed or small tolerance.

Maya: note we have a rebase window at 14:00 UTC today — if we don't land before that we should probably wait until after the freeze unless it's urgent.

Tom: I can take the rerun + rebase if needed. @Olivia do you want me to rebase onto main? I have a free GPU slot for a quick smoke.

Olivia: please rebase first, then Tom run a rerun with unit+smoke only. If green I'll request a merge slot from release lead.

Tom: done rebase and pushed. Rerun command: `/ci rerun pr 10421 --jobs unit,smoke`

CI-bot: Rerun queued. Job IDs: unit-2219, smoke-332. unit PASSED, smoke FAILED — failing log snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected cache size 256 but got 255
File: test_smoke_kv.py:42
```

Jess: that's the same flake I saw. Looks like a non-deterministic eviction threshold. I can open a small test-fix PR to add a tolerance — want me to do that?

Olivia: if it's just a test tolerance change, do it as a follow-up PR. We need the routing fix in before freeze. Options: (a) land without smoke (risky), (b) wait for full CI (likely misses window), (c) land with a temporary kill-switch / canary to limit blast radius. Thoughts?

Rahul: (c) seems safest. Add a kill switch + 1% canary rollout, with auto-rollback on error spike. Low blast radius and we can monitor.

Maya: +1. If there's a kill-switch and canary we can merge pre-freeze. I'll standby to monitor metrics and escalate if needed.

Olivia: I'll add a kill-switch flag to the PR. @Tom can you re-run unit-only after I push the change?

Tom: yep, on it.

CI-bot: unit-2225 PASSED. Integration not run.

Olivia: pushed kill-switch flag change. @release-lead please grant a short pre-freeze merge slot for a 1% canary with auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5%. I'll wire the rollback in the deployment config. Please confirm.

release-lead: slot approved — you have a merge window in ~45 minutes. Keep canary + rollback configured. Good luck :rocket:

Maya: I'll stand by on monitoring and will escalate immediately if error rate climbs.

(End of thread)
